maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The keypoints in the uppermost row are positioned approximately 1.5 spot-diameters above the secondary dense row, maintaining a roughly parallel trajectory with a lateral spacing of 2 spot-widths between individual points.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Estimated 85-90% melanin saturation. The rhinarium is predominantly dark with localized pink/flesh-toned mottling concentrated around the central philtrum and the inferior margins of the nostrils.
